description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Tri-Element Mode III (Fire, Ice, Lightning)], [Magicite Mine Mode] and Magicite +1 to the user

description.name: Explosive Shell
description.text: Six single ranged attacks (0.90 each), grants [Machinist +30% Boost 1] to the user

description.name: Land Mine
description.text: One single ranged attack (6.00) capped at 99999, causes [Imperil Fire 30% (5s)], [Imperil Ice 30% (5s)] and [Imperil Lightning 30% (5s)], 100% additional critical chance if user has Magicite > 0, causes Magicite -1 to the user

description.name: Tri-Element Mode III (Fire, Ice, Lightning)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Ice 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking] after using a Fire/Ice/Lightning ability

description.name: Magicite Mine Mode
description.text: Grants Magicite +1 after using three Machinist abilities, removed after triggering

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
